title: Language tour
goal: The rest of the language on one screen: types, enums, match, typed model calls, an agent with tools, a budget, a test.
notes: ai fn returns a typed value: the reply is parsed into Review or the call is retried.
The agent calls weather(city) with a city the model chose. The city is untrusted, so the URL built from it is refused. The program catches the error and goes on.
Edit anything. model.json holds the replies of the two model functions.
